mapper.sql: e.id, e.user_id, e.employee_no, e.position_id, coalesce(e.position_title, p.post_name) as position_title, e.dept_id, e.manager_user_id, e.employment_type, e.employment_status, e.start_date, e.probation_end_date, e.end_date, e.work_location, e.salary_amount, e.salary_currency, e.pay_frequency, e.emergency_contact, e.emergency_contact_relationship, e.emergency_contact_phone, e.emergency_contact_email, e.notes, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, u.user_name as u_user_name, u.nick_name as u_nick_name, u.email as u_email, u.phonenumber as u_phone, u.status as u_status, d.dept_name as d_dept_name, m.nick_name as m_nick_name

from nad_employee e join sys_user u on u.user_id = e.user_id left join sys_post p on p.post_id = e.position_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = e.dept_id left join sys_user m on m.user_id = e.manager_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into nad_employee (user_id, employee_no, position_id, position_title, dept_id, manager_user_id, employment_type, employment_status, start_date, probation_end_date, end_date, work_location, salary_amount, salary_currency, pay_frequency, emergency_contact, emergency_contact_relationship, emergency_contact_phone, emergency_contact_email, notes, create_by, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{employeeNo}, #{positionId}, #{positionTitle}, #{deptId}, #{managerUserId}, #{employmentType}, #{employmentStatus}, #{startDate}, #{probationEndDate}, #{endDate}, #{workLocation}, #{salaryAmount}, #{salaryCurrency}, #{payFrequency}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyContactRelationship}, #{emergencyContactPhone}, #{emergencyContactEmail}, #{notes}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_employee set employee_no = #{employeeNo}, position_id = #{positionId}, position_title = #{positionTitle}, dept_id = #{deptId}, manager_user_id = #{managerUserId}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, employment_status = #{employmentStatus}, start_date = #{startDate}, probation_end_date = #{probationEndDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, work_location = #{workLocation}, salary_amount = #{salaryAmount}, salary_currency = #{salaryCurrency}, pay_frequency = #{payFrequency}, emergency_contact = #{emergencyContact}, emergency_contact_relationship = #{emergencyContactRelationship}, emergency_contact_phone = #{emergencyContactPhone}, emergency_contact_email = #{emergencyContactEmail}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or u.email like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or e.employee_no like concat('%', #{q}, '%'))
and e.dept_id = #{deptId} and e.employment_status = #{employmentStatus}
order by e.id desc
select where e.salary_amount is not null and e.employment_status <> 'TERMINATED' order by e.salary_currency, e.salary_amount desc
select max(cast(substring(employee_no, char_length(#{prefix}) + 1) as unsigned)) from nad_employee where employee_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
